newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cahya Mata to acquire financial group.
newsitem.headline: Cahya Mata to acquire financial group.

text.p: Cahya Mata Sarawak Bhd (CMSB) said on Tuesday that it proposes to acquire 100 pct of Concordance Holdings Sdn Bhd.

Concordance is the parent of BUMB Holdings Bhd which owns two Sarawak-based financial entities, Bank Utama and Kewangan Utama. Bank Utama is a commercial bank, while Kewangan Utama is a financing company. Sarawak is an eastern Malaysian state on the island of Borneo.
CMSB said in a statement that it is proposing to acquire all 58.64 million ordinary shares in Concordance for a total consideration of 445.50 million ringgit.
In the transaction, CMSB will issue 37.13 million shares at an issue price of 12 ringgit per share.
